author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia is running out of missile interceptors and asking four countries for help because America has none to spare...

Two regional officials say Riyadh has gone to France, Britain, Pakistan and Egypt for air-defense support, an appeal made because its main supplier burned through its own stockpile fighting Iran.

The kingdom has to cover military bases, government sites and oil facilities spread across a country the size of Western Europe, which one official called a very difficult position.

Britain confirms a close defense partnership and will say nothing further.

Turkey and Pakistan told AP they never received a request under the defense pact all three signed last month.

Nobody in that group has interceptors to spare either, with European stocks rated critical months ago and Ukraine already competing for the same missiles off the same lines.

Which leaves the door Oman and Egypt are holding open, and Washington walked through it last weekend when American representatives met Houthi officials in Muscat.

Any settlement built there starts from the map as it stands, with the Houthis holding Bab al-Mandeb and the islands, because there is no force assembling anywhere to take them back.

Source: Associated Press / Writer: Daniel
